announcement.title: 🎨 Landing Page Maker v1.0.4
announcement.content:
Landing Page Maker v1.0.4

  • Removed obsolete alpha-era part files and indexes. Installed part data is reduced from 129.6 MB to 25.2 MB, with the current catalog retained.
  • Retired individual theme fragments can no longer be inserted from old Favorites or Recent entries. Elements already saved in pages, My Assets, and reusable blocks retain their stored content and styles.
  • Identical font files and part previews now share storage without changing font rendering or image quality.
  • Added missing previews for Theater and Obsidian Atlas parts and removed an obsolete preview entry.
